# Static initialization fixture

These small native text files are authored synthetic input for offline worker
contract tests. Names, coordinates and values are arbitrary, with no study or
private model source. Tests supply a non-executable engine placeholder and
replace execution/product export; none of these files qualifies hydraulic
behavior or an installed engine.

Tests materialize this project with explicit CRLF on every platform to match
the existing native writers. A separate LF-source case confirms that preparation
refuses a resulting mixture of newline conventions before execution.
